correctness.rationale: The one-cap Frobenius tensor follows from exact fourth spherical moments in the axial angular-order 0,1,2 sectors. The full two-cap operator is a 2x2 diagonal block plus three off-diagonal quadratic modes with stated beta,gamma,trace T and determinant D. The xz mode exceeds the smaller xy/yz mode by a strictly positive expression in every disjoint admissible configuration. The lower diagonal root and the competing off-diagonal mode strictly decrease with |cos theta|, yielding the unique geometric optimum; beta+gamma>0 ensures root and positivity. At q=0 the diagonal and mixed modes cross exactly at t^2=5/9. Endpoints t in (0,1), caps tangent and antipodal, and no constant/linear harmonics are correctly scoped. Independent fourth-moment numerical integration tested several t and q; finite integrals corroborate but do not prove the all-angle statement.

final_claim: For two equal disjoint-interior spherical caps sampling real homogeneous degree-two harmonics with unrenormalized normalized-sphere area, the least Gram eigenvalue is explicitly algebraic and uniquely maximized at center angle max(2 arccos t, pi/2). For orthogonal caps the minimum-eigenmode multiplicity switches 1 to 3 to 2 at t=sqrt(5)/3.
